title: fix(cli): show device consent in JSON login
author: Saauf

gist.summary: Fixed `polli --json auth login --no-browser` so the verification URL and user code appear on stderr before authorization polling, allowing an agent to show the user how to approve login. Successful explicit login now returns `{"authenticated":true}` on stdout; the shared auth helper remains silent on stdout so it does not disrupt harness or generation output or expose credentials. Documented agent-assisted login in the CLI skill and bumped `polli-cli` to 0.1.43.
